scope: Recorded natural human audiovisual speech stream and synchronization-control infrastructure

source_dataset.name: GRID audiovisual sentence corpus
source_dataset.credit: Cooke, Barker, Cunningham and Shao; GRID corpus, 2006
source_dataset.annotation: Provided spoken-word transcripts and estimated word alignment boundaries; not human lip-onset annotations or open-world visual-event labels
source_dataset.recording_provenance: Human facial video and simultaneously recorded speech; the original paper describes matching camera audio to microphone audio and replacing the video audio track

exclusion_reasons.2: official example used for development format inspection
exclusion_reasons.23: official example used for development format inspection

source_selection.speaker_ranking: ascending SHA256 UTF8(hepta-temporal-speaker-v1|s{integer}); integer breaks hash ties
source_selection.eligible_member: regular .mpg member with s{speaker} as a directory component; exclude __MACOSX and dot-prefixed basenames
source_selection.clip_ranking: ascending SHA256 UTF8(hepta-temporal-clip-v1|s{integer}|{exact_zip_member_path}); member path breaks hash ties
source_selection.selection_before_payload: Fetch ZIP directories only; freeze exact clip and alignment entry names, CRC, sizes and offsets for all 31 groups in selected-source-manifest.json before fetching any selected media or annotation member
source_selection.missing_source_policy: Retain failure without substituting another speaker or clip; no selection based on decoding, semantic quality or policy results
source_selection.dependency_group: speaker and original recording; every shift, dropout, replay, crop and model seed remains nested within its original group

download.method: Public HTTPS byte ranges from author-deposited Zenodo ZIP assets; exact Content-Range and fixed file size required
required_integrity: retained official metadata and its hash
every requested byte range and response SHA256
new SHA256 for every retained original member

allowed: word alignment syntax and raw boundary retention
ffprobe original stream and frame PTS inventory
complete subprocess wall and CPU receipts
forbidden: using evaluation source metrics to tune policy
preparation_only.clock_policy: Use actual per-frame PTS and sample clock; original pilots have 75 decoded frames spaced .04s although r_frame_rate reports 50/1
preparation_only.annotation_timebase: Retain raw integers; mark an inferred candidate scale separately from a documented conversion. Do not equate word acoustic boundaries with lip motion truth.

prospective_control_design_not_executed.required_additional_freeze: Root must approve and publish the full controller, observer qualification, cost and analysis protocol after source preparation and A/B review
prospective_control_design_not_executed.task: Causal repair or re-timing of recorded natural AV streams into actual serialized AV output
prospective_control_design_not_executed.causal_input: Only arrived audio samples and mouth-region visual features up to the current observation cutoff, their observed arrival history and uncommitted output buffer
prohibited_policy_inputs: clean reference timestamps or original uncorrupted stream
prospective_control_design_not_executed.public_clock: Per-channel local increments and actual observed arrival times; no clean cross-channel time origin that discloses the injected label
candidate_actions: wait for the next observation within a fixed latency budget
advance or delay only buffered uncommitted audio or video by one actual frame interval
prospective_control_design_not_executed.irreversibility: Previously committed audio samples and video frames cannot be rewritten
comparison: learned feedback policy after independent calibration
prospective_control_design_not_executed.oracle: Offline full-clip diagnostic upper bound only; never a live policy or online target
prospective_control_design_not_executed.delayed_shared_semantic_benefit: Not established by clock repair. Requires a separately registered shared semantic state and future text/speech/video generation whose multiple future outputs respond to the same state update.

clock_endpoints: actual output stream continuity and PTS
output latency and dropped required content
evaluation_requirements_not_satisfied_by.lip_sync: Requires an independently qualified AVSync or causal content-based offset observer; equal container clocks alone do not establish lip synchronization
evaluation_requirements_not_satisfied_by.cost: Measure separate whole-process download/decode preparation, training, controller/planner, all encoder/decoder calls, buffering, actual mux/write/fsync/reopen, P50/P95 latency and worst-case completion loss
evaluation_requirements_not_satisfied_by.statistics: Resample speaker/source groups; shifts/windows/replays/model seeds do not increase independent speaker count; 16 evaluation groups provide a bounded pilot, not general-domain certification

unclosed_blockers: Mouth-motion/energy correlation is an unqualified baseline and may fail to identify offsets because articulation can lead acoustics or repeat; it is not a factual lip-sync judge
No independent AVSync observer weights, license, source-disjoint calibration or calibrated error threshold are currently registered
Absolute original AV synchronization uncertainty and acoustic word-boundary precision need explicit treatment; injected relative offsets do not certify original physiological synchronization
Mouth ROI localization and all preprocessing must be fixed without evaluation-outcome selection
Packet loss/late-arrival law, learned control method, stopping/commitment rules and quality-versus-compute criterion still require prospective freeze
Existing v7_media is a bounded digit TTS plus independently generated digit-motion adapter, not a natural AV generator or joint speech/video training system
Old motion checkpoint, finite-PCM audit evidence, ASR qualification runner/weights identity and exact historical media training recipe are not recovered
Native multimodal generative training and the complete experiment C scientific claim remain unpassed
